title: The Attention Cost of Stable Matching
abstract: arXiv:2609.09693v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In large markets, scarce attention limits partner evaluation and creates allocation loss, which stability magnifies. In an independent random market with average executable degree $d$, unmatched shares fall at rates $e^{-\sqrt d}$ under stability and $e^{-d}$ under maximum matching on the same graph. Changing consideration can make applications rejected in a provisional active-screen computation relevant again. Exact query-neutral implementation must retain allocation-relevant off-screen authorizations; otherwise, missing authorization must be reacquired. Limited-attention deferred acceptance (LA-DA) preserves valid authorizations and reengages eligible pairs. Conditional on exact next-best information and persistent execution rights, adaptive discovery saves a logarithmic factor in reached proposals relative to independent exposure. translated_title: 稳定匹配的注意力成本
translated_abstract: 在大市场中，稀缺的注意力限制了对候选伙伴的评估并造成分配损失，而稳定性会放大这种损失。在一个平均可执行度为 $d$ 的独立随机市场中，在同一图上，稳定匹配下的未匹配份额以 $e^{-\sqrt d}$ 的速率下降，而最大匹配下的未匹配份额则以 $e^{-d}$ 的速率下降。改变考虑范围可以使在临时主动筛选计算中被拒绝的申请重新变得相关。精确的查询中立实现必须保留与分配相关的屏幕外授权；否则，缺失的授权必须重新获取。有限注意力延迟接受算法（LA-DA）保留了有效授权并重新激活符合条件的配对。在具备精确的次优信息和持久执行权的条件下，相对于独立暴露，自适应发现在已达成的提案数量上节省了一个对数因子。在一项速配应用的实证中，双边报告使我们能够在相同的候选池上比较稳定匹配与最大匹配。
tldr: 该论文揭示了稳定性会放大稀缺注意力造成的分配损失——同一图上稳定匹配的未匹配率以 $e^{-\sqrt d}$ 下降而最大匹配以 $e^{-d}$ 下降——并提出保留有效授权的有限注意力延迟接受算法（LA-DA），可将提案成本降低一个对数因子。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that stability amplifies attention-driven allocation loss—unmatched shares decay as $e^{-\sqrt d}$ under stability versus $e^{-d}$ under maximum matching on the same graph—and proposes a limited-attention deferred acceptance algorithm (LA-DA) that preserves valid authorizations and saves a logarithmic factor in reached proposals.
